title: kanban ledger config.yaml (format 3)
description: The kanban/config.yaml of a ledger, format version 3. Derived from docs/ledger.md; where they differ, ledger.md is right. Unknown keys are allowed (readers ignore them, writers keep them).

title.description: A name to show. The project's slug when absent.

prefix.description: Prefix of new issue ids (<prefix>-<n>). One plain name: no /, \ or :, and not . or ... Default W.

columns.description: The statuses, in board order. The last one means done. Default [todo, queued, doing, review, done].

phases.description: Ordered stages, for timeline views. Default [].

repos.description: The project's repositories as <host>/<owner>/<repo>, the path ghq gives them: three names, no leading or trailing /. Default [].

chief_of_staff.description: The terminal of the project's Chief of Staff: its herdr-core address on the ledger's own machine (t2). Set with kanban config set chief_of_staff=<address>.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone (Asia/Tokyo) in which routines' schedule is read. Default UTC.
